items.headline: A 5.73M-SPX wallet split into 5 fresh wallets
items.detail: 2026-08-10. The pieces inherit the source's coin age, so it's a move, not new buying — often a holder breaking up a position to sit below the radar. Flagged unverified (same-block heuristic) — worth an eyeball.
